aiSummary.oneLiner: An analytical archive of leaked system prompts from major commercial AI applications.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository serves as an educational archive and analysis project focused on documenting leaked or reverse-engineered system prompts from prominent AI services. It categorizes the underlying instructions used by companies to constrain and guide their large language models. The project analyzes these prompts to identify common security vulnerabilities, alignment strategies, and prompt engineering techniques used in production. It highlights the difficulties in securing LLMs against prompt injection and extraction attacks. The archive provides valuable real-world data for researchers studying AI safety and application design.
keyFeatures: Prompt archive: A meticulously organized collection of documented system prompts from various services.
Vulnerability analysis: Detailed breakdowns of how specific prompts were extracted or bypassed.
Security categorization: Groups prompts based on the specific constraints they attempt to enforce.
Mitigation strategies: Offers theoretical improvements to make the leaked prompts more robust.
Historical tracking: Monitors how companies update their system prompts in response to known leaks.

useCases.title: AI safety research
useCases.description: Provides raw data for academic researchers studying the effectiveness of prompt-based alignment.

useCases.title: Security auditing
useCases.description: Helps penetration testers understand common defensive patterns to better test their own AI applications.

useCases.title: Prompt engineering education
useCases.description: Demonstrates real-world examples of how large organizations structure complex LLM instructions.

useCases.title: Application design
useCases.description: Informs developers on what to avoid when crafting system prompts for their own user-facing AI tools.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Aimed at AI safety researchers, security professionals, and advanced prompt engineers. Users should have a solid understanding of LLM mechanics and common attack vectors like prompt injection.
